title: GalleryContent
description: Gallery hero content: the heading, a description, up to two actions and three or four photos. One object is valid in every gallery layout (a grid of photos at the end or the start, layered photos at the end or under the copy).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

secondaryActionLabel.description: the label of the second action (the secondary button after the first); drawn when the label and the address are both set; empty: none

secondaryActionHref.description: the address of the second action

photos.description: the photos, in the order they are shown (the layout shows three or four)

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.description: address of the photo; none: the placeholder
